cohort: 47 Finnish women with cartilage-hair hypoplasia, of whom 14 had been pregnant
finding: Despite significant short stature, most pregnancies in women with cartilage-hair hypoplasia lead to a term cesarean section delivery, and fetal growth is generally unaffected.
mod_finding: All women with cartilage-hair hypoplasia delivered by cesarean section, mostly due to evident cephalo-pelvic disproportion.
